entities.summary: Ecem Alıcı is a Turkish volleyball player. She is 181 cm (5.94 ft) tall at 66 kg (146 lb) and plays in the wing spiker position. She plays in the Aydın Büyükşehir Belediyespor, which competes in the Turkish Women's Volleyball League. Alıcı is a member of the Turkey women's youth national volleyball team, and wears number 14.
